description: This Java class implements the SmsCampaignDropdownReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve various dropdown options related to SMS campaigns, such as trigger types, SMS providers, campaign types, months, weeks, and period frequency types. It interacts with external services to fetch data and defines logic specific to SMS campaign configurations in the project.

classes.name: SmsCampaignDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing dropdown data retrieval for SMS campaigns, including trigger types, providers, campaign types, months, weeks, and frequency types.

methods.name: retrieveCampaignTriggerTypes
methods.description: Returns a collection of trigger types for SMS campaigns, such as direct, schedule, and triggered.

methods.name: retrieveSmsProviders
methods.description: Fetches and returns a collection of available SMS providers by making an external REST API call, with error handling for unavailable services.

methods.name: retrieveCampaignTypes
methods.description: Returns a collection of SMS campaign types, currently filtering for SMS campaigns.

methods.name: retrieveMonths
methods.description: Provides a collection of months for scheduling or selection purposes.

methods.name: retrieveWeeks
methods.description: Provides a collection of week days options for scheduling purposes.

methods.name: retrivePeriodFrequencyTypes
methods.description: Returns different period frequency types applicable for scheduling campaigns.
